description: Which companies name one subprocessor on their published lists, with the name each company prints for it, when it was first seen on that list and when the list was read. One subprocessor per call. Free to read, cite and link. Every row is a dated quote of a company's own published page: cite the page and the read date. The compilation is protected: extraction or re-use of a substantial part is not permitted, and it may never be compiled into a lead list, a prospecting feed or a sales tool. A key is one reader's own use.
